_comment: Project settings of the harness checks. Every key is optional: a missing key keeps the default from harness/core/scripts/harness_config.py, where each key is explained. Nested objects merge key by key, lists replace the default.
_generated: Path prefixes the build or the deploy rewrites, e.g. ["web/dist/"]: they do not make the tree dirty.
_build_stamp: Optional build provenance, e.g. {"file": "web/dist/version.json", "key": "version"}: the value starts with the short HEAD, "+" right after it for a dirty tree.

scan._id_patterns: Project identifiers that must never land in git, e.g. [{"name": "customer id", "regex": "(?<![\\w.,:/#-])C\\d{7}(?![\\w.,:/-])"}].

deploy_check._openapi_cmd: e.g. "{python} -c \"import json, sys; from app.main import app; json.dump(app.openapi(), sys.stdout)\""; null skips the API contract.
